context:
Goal: every gap a lane finds gets fixed or removed, not filed and forgotten.
Problem (rule): claude-settings main holds 1,501 notes lines and 121 debt files. Rule roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes sends each finding Claude is unlikely to hit to notes.md, and a note becomes work only after a real incident. So notes never get a lane. Only 28 lines mention the round-3 cap, so that rule is a small part of it.
Based on (measured): `git show origin/main:docs/debts/notes.md | grep -c '^- '` = 1501, 13:33 CST.
Based on (read): lane qmax-debts-one-home found 58 q_max decisions that still carry a "Holes, named" section, a second home for a known gap. They wait on this answer too (13:33 CST).
Based on (ruling): rule roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes. Asked again because your 13:20 and 13:28 CST questions challenge what it leaves behind.
Departs from: main, where a note waits for an incident — every note carries a fix or a reason (step notes-name-their-fix), and the backlog is sorted.

options.gain: Each one is fixed (it becomes a step with a lane), deleted (already fixed or stale), or kept with a `Fix: none` reason. The backlog empties into real work or nothing.
options.label: One sort lane over all 1,501 lines and 121 debts (recommended)
options.lose: One big lane, plus the fix lanes it starts.

options.label: A lane for every line
options.lose: About 1,600 lanes, many for stale or trivial lines.

options.label: Leave the backlog; only new lines must name a fix

short: Notes backlog: sort it, a lane each, or leave it
title: Sort the 1,501 notes lines and 121 debts into fix, delete, or keep-with-reason?
why: You asked at 13:20 CST "why not fix it then" and at 13:28 CST "should we send a lane on all of them?".
